topic: Self-Hosted LangSmith Guide 2026: Production LLM Observability on Your Infrastructure

competitors.title: Self-host LangSmith on Kubernetes - Official Docs
key_points: Self-hosting is an add-on to the Enterprise Plan for security-conscious customers
Deployed via Helm chart on Kubernetes (GKE, EKS, AKS, OpenShift, Minikube/Kind)
Requires LangSmith License Key, API Key Salt, and JWT Secret
Minimum cluster: 16 vCPUs, 64GB memory; ClickHouse needs 4 vCPUs, 16GB if in-cluster
Uses PostgreSQL, Redis, and ClickHouse databases (external managed services recommended)
SSDs recommended with 7000 IOPS and 1000 MiB/s throughput
Terraform modules available for AWS and Azure infrastructure provisioning
Egress to beacon.langchain.com required for license verification (unless offline mode)
Components: ace-backend, backend, clickhouse, frontend, ingest-queue, platform-backend, playground, postgres, queue, redis

competitors.title: LangSmith Plans and Pricing
key_points: Developer plan: $0/seat/mo with 5k base traces/mo
Plus plan: $39/seat/mo with 10k base traces/mo
Enterprise plan: Custom pricing with self-hosted, hybrid, and BYOC options
Self-hosted ensures data never leaves your VPC
Enterprise includes custom SSO, RBAC, support SLA, team trainings
SmithDB: purpose-built database for agent observability
SmithDB benchmarks: 12x faster trace queries, 9x thread queries, 15x full-text search, 6x filtering vs general-purpose DBs

competitors.title: LangSmith: AI Agent & LLM Observability Platform
key_points: Full visibility into LLM applications: traces, production-wide performance metrics
Integrations with OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and more
SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java
OpenTelemetry support for existing observability pipelines
SmithDB: three stateless components on object storage and Postgres, no local disks or complex sharding
Features: Tracing, Monitoring, Insights, Online evals, Annotation queues, Prompt Hub
Enterprise customers include Klarna, Lyft, Gong, Harvey, Cloudflare, Nvidia, LinkedIn, Uber

competitors.title: LangSmith Self-Hosted Overview - Official Docs
key_points: Three deployment options: Cloud, Hybrid, and Self-hosted
Self-hosted option for teams with data residency and compliance requirements
All options include observability, evaluation, prompt engineering, and deployment
Self-hosted can be extended with Deployment, Fleet, Insights, and Chat features
Supports non-root and read-only container policies for security-conscious environments

stats.fact: Self-hosting LangSmith requires a minimum Kubernetes cluster of 16 vCPUs and 64GB memory
ClickHouse in-cluster requires at least 4 vCPUs and 16GB allocatable memory
SmithDB delivers 12x faster trace queries, 9x thread queries, 15x full-text search, and 6x filtering compared to general-purpose databases
LangSmith Developer plan is free with 5,000 base traces per month
LangSmith Plus plan costs $39/seat/month with 10,000 base traces per month
Self-hosting is an add-on to the Enterprise Plan designed for the largest, most security-conscious customers
LangSmith supports SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java
LangSmith integrates with OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and OpenTelemetry
SmithDB can be self-hosted inside your VPC as three stateless components on object storage and Postgres
LangSmith is used by enterprise customers including Klarna, Lyft, Gong, Harvey, Cloudflare, Nvidia, LinkedIn, and Uber
LangSmith supports GKE, EKS, AKS, OpenShift 4.14+, Minikube, and Kind Kubernetes distributions
Terraform modules are available for provisioning AWS and Azure infrastructure for LangSmith
SSD storage with 7000 IOPS and 1000 MiB/s throughput is recommended for production deployments
LangSmith requires egress to beacon.langchain.com for license verification unless running in offline mode
